current_connected_project.reason: A new chat inside the same project still has filesystem, project-instruction and project-memory exposure. Conversation freshness is not input isolation.

official_behavior_relied_on.claim: Auto memory is project-local and all worktrees/subdirectories of one Git repository share it; MEMORY.md is loaded at conversation start.
Sessions are saved conversations tied to a project directory and can be resumed or searched across projects by ID.
Claude Code reads instructions, settings, hooks, skills and memory from the project and user .claude directories.
Bare non-interactive mode can start without host hooks, plugins, auto memory or CLAUDE.md when the execution surface permits it.

requirements: new conversation, not resume, continue, branch, fork or subagent of an old session
new cloud environment with no mounted repository and no connected file-store or code-search connector
full session and tool transcript retained until independent acceptance
use only if the Code platform requires a repository
new repository with a new root commit containing only the blind capsule or its extracted sealed files
no fork, mirror, import, template, submodule, alternate object database or remote relation to the baseline
new cloud environment and new no-context session
the sterile repository identity and complete tree hash recorded before launch
only if a genuinely separate sandbox/container/VM can mount the blind input read-only and an empty output writable
fresh CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and bare mode so host hooks, plugins, auto memory and CLAUDE.md do not load
the baseline repository and prior study storage are not mounted
complete transcript and environment attestation preserved

preflight_must_pass_before_units_are_spe: workspace contains only the sealed blind capsule inputs
no baseline repository, Git object, prior study artifact, project memory, CLAUDE.md, session transcript or reviewer capsule is present
no connector can retrieve the baseline or prior study
the new session is not a resume, branch, fork or inherited subagent
the producer reports no prior architecture knowledge in its initial context
blind capsule and reviewer commitment hashes match the outer freeze manifest

evidence_model.primary: Physical absence of forbidden inputs in a new environment plus the fixed input inventory and retained platform transcript, used to qualify the blind-independence claim.
evidence_model.corroborating: The producer's append-only access ledger and research ledger.
evidence_model.explicit_non_claim: A producer-written logger is not an OS monitor and is never treated as independent evidence. Isolation evidence is provenance evidence, not the final optimality proof.
evidence_model.network_rule: No named-project, repository or prior-study search is permitted. Public research queries and URLs must be visible in the retained transcript and research ledger.

immediate_stop_conditions: any prior project memory or answer appears
any baseline or prior-study file/path/repository is visible
the environment cannot establish its exact initial input inventory
on_stop: When detected before architecture work, do not continue research; record PRELAUNCH_ISOLATION_BLOCKED and provision a truly clean route once. If missing evidence is discovered after work, preserve the candidate with BLINDNESS_UNVERIFIED rather than repeating Phase 2. The final ceiling depends on the universal proof, not this label.
